remarks:
This recreational land with building site sits on 6 acres with apple trees located in South Dayton NY, Chautauqua County.

The land is mostly level with some rolling hills.  It is wooded right off the road and in the back of the property.  The land is open with some shrubs in the middle of the property, and is loaded with apple trees.  Perfect location to park your camper, or build your cabin or home with ultimate privacy.  A natural spring runs through the back portion of the property which would be a perfect opportunity to build a pond.  Electric is located at the road and has 314 feet of road frontage.  There is a trail cut for easy access of the property. Additional acreage is available upon request.  All rights convey.

This property is located approximately 12 minutes to Forestville, 20 minutes to Gowanda, 25 minutes to Dunkirk, 40 minutes to Springville, 50 minutes to Buffalo, and 1 hour 10 minutes to Erie.
